description: Made-up interviews and queries for testing the evaluation harness. Not archive content and not real speech. The Nepali lines were written by an AI assistant and are not a verified translation. There is no Nepal Bhasa: add it only from a speaker or a consented recording. Replace with queries labelled against real (or consented pilot) transcripts before drawing conclusions.

lines.text: बिहान सबेरै हामी स्तूपको परिक्रमा गर्थ्यौं।
lines.english: Early in the morning we used to walk around the stupa.

lines.text: बाटोमा धेरै बाँदरहरू हुन्थे, उनीहरूले खाना खोसेर लैजान्थे।
lines.english: There were many monkeys on the path, they would snatch food away.

lines.text: मेरी हजुरआमाले माने घुमाउँदै मन्त्र जप्नुहुन्थ्यो।
lines.english: My grandmother would chant mantras while turning the prayer wheels.

lines.text: हामी केटाकेटीहरू सिँढीहरू गन्दै माथि दौडन्थ्यौं।
lines.english: We children would run up counting the steps.

lines.text: बर्खामा सिँढी चिप्लो हुन्थ्यो, त्यसैले बिस्तारै हिँड्नुपर्थ्यो।
lines.english: In the monsoon the steps were slippery, so we had to walk slowly.

lines.text: पसलेहरूले धूप र बत्ती बेच्थे।
साँझ परेवाहरूलाई दाना खुवाउन मानिसहरू जम्मा हुन्थे।
lines.english: In the evening people gathered to feed grain to the pigeons.

lines.text: त्यो दृश्य अहिले पनि मेरो आँखामा छ।
lines.english: That scene is still in my eyes.

lines.text: भूकम्पपछि हर्मिकाको माथिल्लो भाग चर्किएको थियो।
lines.english: After the earthquake the upper part of the harmika had cracked.

lines.text: गुठीका मानिसहरूले मर्मतका लागि चन्दा उठाए।
lines.english: People from the guthi collected donations for the repairs.

lines.text: कालिगढहरूले नयाँ सुनको जलप चढाए।
lines.english: Craftsmen applied a new gold plating.

lines.text: काम सकिन झन्डै एक वर्ष लाग्यो।
lines.english: It took almost a year to finish the work.

lines.text: पुनः अभिषेकको दिन ठूलो पूजा भयो।
lines.english: On the day of reconsecration there was a big puja.

lines.text: टाढा टाढाबाट भक्तहरू आएका थिए।
lines.english: Devotees had come from far away.

lines.text: त्यस दिन आकाशमा इन्द्रेणी देखियो।
सबैले त्यसलाई शुभ सङ्केत माने।
lines.english: Everyone took it as an auspicious sign.

lines.text: During Buddha Jayanti the whole hill was covered in prayer flags.
My father hung new flags every year with our neighbours.
There was music from the monastery all through the night.
We ate beaten rice and drank tea at a small stall.
Later I moved abroad for work and missed the festival for ten years.
When I came back the stalls had become proper shops.
Tourists photographed the eyes painted on the stupa.
But for us it was always a place of worship, not a sight.
